intro: Elder Runetotem is an ancestral tauren spirit appearing outside Razor Hill in Durotar during the Lunar Festival. As one of the revered elders of the Horde, she offers wisdom and her blessing to travelers who seek her out across the red canyons.

p: Though ancestral tauren spirits are typically tied to the grassy plains and sacred burial grounds of Mulgore, Elder Runetotem lingers far from the pastures of her people. She manifests beside the dusty settlement of Razor Hill in Durotar. To young orcs and wandering adventurers, her ethereal presence serves as a bridge between the ancient traditions of the Shu'halo and the harsh new home the Horde has carved along the Great Sea.

During the Lunar Festival, the spirits of great leaders, shamans, and heroes manifest throughout the world to commune with the living. Elder Runetotem represents the Runetotem line—a lineage known for deep reverence for the Earth Mother and spiritual communion. Travelers honoring her presence are granted ancestral tokens and her spiritual blessing.
